Firstlight Hatchery

Indie dev studio (1 founder + 2 contractors) building a tiny code-assistant + docs search for indie SaaS makers. Came in via product hunt link and signed up in the morning. Wants hosted API to avoid infra work; prefers public cloud only. Key asks: low per-token cost for embeddings, streaming chat for interactive code suggestions, small SDKs, predictable rate limits for realtime tool. Quote from founder: "We need something we can ship in a weekend and not think about infra for 6 months." Experimented with 3 open models from catalog; liked latency on smaller Llama variant but wants GPT-like completion quality for code. Concerned about token costs and how caching/batching will affect bills. No AE touch yet; will likely convert to paid if we resolve rate limit + pricing clarity. Typical workload: embedding refreshes nightly (~5k docs), live chat sessions ~10 concurrent users during beta, batch rerank for search on demand. Compliance: not strict — mostly public content and user-provided snippets; wants basic audit logs and ability to export logs if needed. Next steps: send tailored quickstart with example repo, include tiny-js and micro-python snippets, explain rate-limit tiers + burst capacity, add note about how prefix caching reduces token usage. Follow-up schedule: auto-email 3 days after nudge, then manual outreach if usage rises above free credits.
